Who is Aya?

The next time the goes out, will ask Link to bring it back in one minute. After this is done, will reward with a . When the goes out a third time, asks to relight the in less than twenty seconds. The reward for doing this is a . On subsequent visits, however, she will only be able to give 20 .

If the is extinguished while it is , will remark that should not retrieve it due to the poor weather.
